name: Crypto 20-Day Trend Breakout
hypothesis: Time-series momentum: fresh 20-day H4 closing breakouts aligned with a sloping 50-day baseline in BTC/ETH continue over the following days.
risk_model: One planned risk unit; 3x H4 ATR(30) stop; 3R objective; time limit = min(7 days, next Friday 20:45 UTC); no entry with <24h to that break; long-side swap financing included by the evaluator.
known_limitations: No verified edge. Few independent events per year; BTC/ETH highly correlated; long financing (swap mode 5) is material over multi-day holds; weekend liquidity. v0.2.0 change is a data/session compatibility fix after v0.1.0 had 22/37 trades unresolvable across the weekly broker gap; entry rules unchanged. v0.3.0: 50-day baseline computed from D1 closes instead of 300 H4 closes because the live collector cache keeps ~200 bars per timeframe (v0.2.0 could never fire live). Its test-period figures are not independent: v0.2.0 test results were seen first.
